items.task:
# Changed example: the first long title

Export `firstLongTitle(titles, minLength)` from your module.

- `titles` is an array of strings, `minLength` a nonnegative integer.
- Return the FIRST title (in array order) whose length is strictly greater than `minLength`.
- A title whose length EQUALS `minLength` is not long enough.
- Return `null` when no title qualifies (including for an empty array).
- Do not mutate `titles`.

This is the U01 delayed transfer: same loop-and-return skill as `remainingTitles`, a different rule and a boundary you must define yourself.

tests.name: returns the first title longer than the limit
a title exactly at the limit is not longer
first in order, not the longest
empty input and no match return null

items.wrongBecause: treats a title whose length equals the limit as long enough (>= instead of >): exactly the equality boundary the transfer asks you to define and test
